besluite.rede: 'Begin met 'n stokkie op die hoek' is a natural Afrikaans instruction; the proposal is longer and only reads differently.
Same sentence and same proposal the previous round dropped; 'stuk' reads naturally and is kept for consistency.
Previous round dropped adding 'op' to this unchanged sentence; 'rol tot 'n stut' is acceptable Afrikaans, as in 'rol die deeg tot 'n bal'.

besluite.fout: Three instances of 'sy' in one sentence, one a noun and two pronouns, make a Grade 4 reader stumble.
besluite.rede: 'Van die kant af' is the natural idiom for the direction and removes the noun/pronoun clash without changing the action.

besluite.fout: 'Hom op sy ente laat meegee' is compressed, so it is unclear whether 'op sy ente' describes where the force goes or how it gives way.
besluite.rede: Naming the pressing on the ends makes the same comparison plain, matching the earlier 'druk ... op sy boonste ent'.
Glossary definition, unchanged since the previous round dropped this same change; 'klein pennetjie' is not a grammar error.
